en.headline: Police seize 5.7kg of suspected cannabis from Tsuen Wan mini-storage
en.dek: Officers from the Tsuen Wan Police District Special Duties Team arrested a 28-year-old local man after finding about half a kilogramme on him and a further 5kg in a nearby storage unit.
body: Tsuen Wan police dismantled a drug distribution centre on Tuesday night, seizing about 5.7 kilogrammes of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of HK$1.1 million.

The Tsuen Wan Police District Special Duties Team said the operation followed intelligence analysis and investigation. Officers intercepted a suspicious local man at an industrial building and found about half a kilogramme of suspected cannabis buds in a paper bag he was carrying.

A subsequent search of a nearby mini-storage unit uncovered a further 5 kilogrammes of suspected cannabis buds. The 28-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs and is being detained for investigation.
Police reminded the public that trafficking in dangerous drugs carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance.

zh.headline: 警方搞破荃灣迷你倉毒品分銷中心 檢獲約5.7公斤大麻花
zh.dek: 荃灣警區特別職務隊截查一名28歲本地男子，在其紙袋檢獲約半公斤懷疑大麻花，其後在附近迷你倉再檢獲約5公斤。
body: 荃灣警方周二晚搞破一個區內毒品分銷中心，檢獲約5.7公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約110萬港元。
荃灣警區特別職務隊表示，行動源於情報分析及調查。人員在一座工業大廈截查一名行跡可疑的本地男子，在其手持紙袋內發現約半公斤懷疑大麻花。
其後搜查附近一個迷你倉，再檢獲約5公斤懷疑大麻花。該名28歲男子因涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕，正被扣留調查。
警方提醒市民，根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物一經定罪，最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
